name: divergence-gt-as-max
note: FCB-ONLY SEMANTICS: in FCB's bespoke engine '>' means MAX, so MAX(8,2) = 8. expression-kit/EvalEx treats '>' as a boolean greater-than comparison: 8 > 2 is TRUE, coerced to 1 by EvaluationValue.getNumberValue(). EvalEx returns 1, NOT FCB's 8. This fixture asserts EvalEx's ACTUAL behavior to DOCUMENT the divergence; expectedResult=1 records the EvalEx-observed value, not the FCB value (which would be 8).
